(blocking) Effect dropped `postId` dependency and cancellation ... the previous post's comments stay on screen under the new post ... an out-of-order response race comes back

(should_fix) O(n²) dedupe on threads of several thousand comments ... Fix: `new Set(comments.map((c) => c.author.id)).size` and wrap it in `useMemo`
(should_fix) New `moment` dependency duplicates `date-fns` ... `src/format.ts` already exports `relativeTime()`. `moment` is in maintenance mode
(should_fix) Tests cover only the happy path for bold ... no test covers italic, code, links, nesting, HTML escaping or `javascript:` links
